compact._comment: Trimmed JSON view with only the fields that vary meaningfully - same underlying record as pan:traffic/pan:threat, fewer fields rendered

_comment: Palo Alto Networks (PAN-OS) firewall session generator
_description: Models one firewall session observed by a PAN-OS perimeter firewall: identified by App-ID, evaluated against policy, and either allowed through to completion, denied by policy before an app could be identified, or allowed initially but terminated mid-session by a threat detection. Every session emits one Traffic log at teardown; sessions terminated by a threat additionally emit one Threat log. Field names, real field order, and value vocabulary (App-ID names/categories, vendor action terms, threat names/categories/severities) come from the Splunk_TA_paloalto_networks add-on's extract_traffic/extract_threat field lists and lookups/app_list.csv, lookups/threat_list.csv, lookups/pan_vendor_actions_300.csv, lookups/pan_severity.csv.
